title: A Big Policy Change at the Border

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之爱及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至在我还在黑胶唱片时代夜店打碟的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上你都要带着300件最珍贵的传家宝去工作，你把DJ台变成了一个美丽的、拥有50年历史的文物的微型流动流行博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼迎推出的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, for the past three years, the United States has relied on an emergency health rule to solve its immigration problems at the U.S.-Mexico border.
sentences.zh: 今天，在过去的三年里，美国一直依靠一项紧急卫生条例来解决其美墨边境的移民问题。

sentences.en: By the end of the week, that rule will expire.
sentences.zh: 到本周末，这项条例将失效。

sentences.en: My colleague, Miriam Jordan, has been reporting on what that will mean for those on both sides of the border.
sentences.zh: 我的同事米里亚姆·乔丹一直在报道这对于边境两侧的人们意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, May 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月9日，星期二。

sentences.en: Miriam, I wonder if you can walk us through precisely what's happening at the border on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆，我想知道你是否能为我们详细介绍一下周四边境具体会发生什么。

sentences.en: Well, at 11.59 p.m.
sentences.zh: 好的，在晚上11点59分，

sentences.en: Eastern time, the Biden administration is lifting an emergency health rule that has been used to prevent hundreds of thousands of migrants, many of them seeking asylum,
sentences.zh: 东部时间，拜登政府将解除一项紧急卫生条例，该条例曾被用来阻止数十万寻求庇护的移民，其中许多人都在寻求庇护，

sentences.en: from entering the United States.
sentences.zh: 进入美国。

sentences.en: That rule is called Title 42.
sentences.zh: 这项条例被称为“第42条”。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we've talked about Title 42 a lot on this show.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中经常讨论第42条。

sentences.en: But just explain where Title 42 comes from and what exactly it has done.
sentences.zh: 但请解释一下第42条的来源以及它具体做了什么。

sentences.en: Well, Title 42 was imposed three years ago by President Trump under the premise of preventing the spread of COVID-19 to the American public.
sentences.zh: 好的，第42条是三年前由特朗普总统以防止新冠病毒向美国公众传播为由实施的。

sentences.en: But it was essentially used as a border control tool because, quite simply, it has allowed U.S.
sentences.zh: 但它本质上被用作边境控制工具，因为很简单，它允许美国

sentences.en: border officials to very quickly turn away most migrants who show up trying to enter the United States.
sentences.zh: 边境官员非常迅速地遣返大多数试图进入美国的移民。

sentences.en: No hearing, no chance to ask for asylum, nothing.
sentences.zh: 没有听证会，没有申请庇护的机会，什么都没有。

sentences.en: They're literally expelled within minutes.
sentences.zh: 他们字面意义上在几分钟内就被驱逐了。

sentences.en: Which is not the normal situation.
sentences.zh: 这并非正常情况。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: This replaced the previous system that critics sometimes labeled catch and release because migrants were able to turn themselves in to Border Patrol agents,
sentences.zh: 这取代了以前的系统，批评人士有时称之为“抓了又放”，因为移民能够向边境巡逻人员自首，

sentences.en: say that they wanted asylum, and then were allowed to wait in the United States for the outcome of their immigration case for years.
sentences.zh: 说他们想要庇护，然后被允许在美国等待他们的移民案件结果长达数年之久。

sentences.en: And they might never leave.
sentences.zh: 而且他们可能永远不会离开。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It was a system whereby, in the crudest possible terms, if you came to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 用最粗俗的话来说，这是一个系统，如果你来到美国

sentences.en: and asked for asylum, it was a way of staying in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 并申请庇护，这是一种留在美国的方式

sentences.en: for quite some time.
sentences.zh: 相当长的一段时间。

sentences.en: Yes, that is correct.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是正确的。

sentences.en: Asylum doesn't happen overnight.
sentences.zh: 庇护并非一朝一夕的事。

sentences.en: Applicants have to wait for years for their cases to resolve in court.
sentences.zh: 申请人必须等待多年，他们的案件才能在法庭上解决。

sentences.en: The reality on the ground that that system generated became very frustrating, particularly to Republicans and the administration of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 该系统在实地造成的现实变得令人非常沮丧，尤其是对共和党人和唐纳德·特朗普政府而言。

sentences.en: And that triggered a major change in policy.
sentences.zh: 这引发了一项重大政策变革。

sentences.en: And that policy change was to block asylum seekers from entering the United States using Title 42 and the health emergency rationale of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 而这一政策变革就是利用第42条和疫情的健康紧急状态理由，阻止寻求庇护者进入美国。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 正确。

sentences.en: You know, people from many countries who touch U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道，来自许多国家的踏上美国

sentences.en: soil and turn themselves in to the Border Patrol or were apprehended by agents were now swiftly expelled back to Mexico or placed on deportation flights back to their home countries.
sentences.zh: 土地并向边境巡逻队自首或被特工逮捕的人，现在被迅速驱逐回墨西哥或登上返回其祖国的驱逐航班。

sentences.en: And, you know, obviously, the pandemic emergency has ended, so there's no justification for keeping this policy in place.
sentences.zh: 而且，显而易见，疫情紧急状态已经结束，因此没有理由继续保留这项政策。

sentences.en: Miriam, what does it look like at the border right now as this emergency policy, Title 42,
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆，随着这项紧急政策（第42条）的结束，目前的边境情况是怎样的？

sentences.en: that really served as a message to those seeking asylum that they shouldn't come to the border because the old rules weren't going to apply?
sentences.zh: 这项政策实际上向寻求庇护者传达了一个信息，即他们不应该来到边境，因为旧规则将不再适用？

sentences.en: What does it look like as that now ends?
sentences.zh: 随着这一切的结束，情况是怎样的？

sentences.en: Well, I guess it's mayhem.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想这就是混乱。

sentences.en: Tonight, the scenes of pure desperation growing on the border, waves of migrants surging across the Rio Grande River into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今晚，边境上绝望的景象愈演愈烈，一波又一波的移民涌过格兰德河进入美国。

sentences.en: We've seen a substantial increase in the number of migrants trying to cross into the United States ahead of this policy shift.
sentences.zh: 我们看到，在这项政策转变之前，试图越境进入美国的移民人数大幅增加。

sentences.en: A large crowd of migrants are gathering at the U.S.
sentences.zh: 一大群移民正聚集在美国

sentences.en: southern border with Mexico.
sentences.zh: 与墨西哥南部边境。

sentences.en: So they're waiting to be apprehended.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在等待被捕。

sentences.en: And we've also seen very large numbers of migrants amassing in border cities on the Mexican side.
sentences.zh: 我们也看到大量移民聚集在墨西哥一侧的边境城市。

sentences.en: Migrants grasping for what food and supplies they can get through the border wall in El Paso.
sentences.zh: 移民在埃尔帕索的边境墙抓取他们能得到的食物和物资。

sentences.en: With hopes of crossing after the policy sunsets.
sentences.zh: 怀着在政策失效后过境的希望。

sentences.en: The new group of migrants are doing what they can to stay warm as they wait for what is sometimes hours to be processed.
sentences.zh: 这群新移民尽其所能保持温暖，同时等待有时长达数小时的处理。

sentences.en: There's confusion.
sentences.zh: 存在困惑。

sentences.en: Some people think it will become more difficult to enter the U.S.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为进入美国将变得更加困难。

sentences.en: So they want to come as soon as possible before 11.59 p.m.
sentences.zh: 所以他们想在周四晚上11点59分之前尽快赶到。

sentences.en: on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 星期四。

sentences.en: Many others think it's going to become easier afterwards.
sentences.zh: 许多其他人认为之后会变得更容易。

sentences.en: Border towns are already stretched.
sentences.zh: 边境城镇已经不堪重负。

sentences.en: El Paso declaring a state of emergency, saying 1,350 migrants arrive there every day already.
sentences.zh: 埃尔帕索宣布进入紧急状态，称每天已有1350名移民抵达那里。

sentences.en: Outside a church in downtown El Paso last week, there are about 2,000 migrants who had recently managed to cross the border,
sentences.zh: 上周在埃尔帕索市中心的一座教堂外面，大约有2000名最近设法过境的移民，

sentences.en: sleeping on the sidewalk on these collapsed cardboard boxes.
sentences.zh: 睡在这些压扁的纸箱的人行道上。

sentences.en: You know, some children were begging.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有些孩子在乞讨。

sentences.en: Migrants were trying to figure out how they were going to get to their destinations across the country.
sentences.zh: 移民们正试图弄清楚他们将如何前往全国各地的目的地。

sentences.en: It was really sad.
sentences.zh: 这真的很悲伤。

sentences.en: This young woman who came to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这位来到美国的年轻女性

sentences.en: saying there are many more coming, trying to escape violence and economic collapse back home.
sentences.zh: 说还有更多的人来，试图逃离家乡的暴力和经济崩溃。

sentences.en: So some of the migrants who are now massing at the border think that the end of Title 42 means it's going to be harder to get into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，现在聚集在边境的一些移民认为，第42条的结束意味着对他们来说进入美国将更加困难。

sentences.en: for them.
sentences.zh: 对他们而言。

sentences.en: Others think when Title 42 expires, it's going to be easier.
sentences.zh: 其他人则认为，当第42条失效时，事情会变得更容易。

sentences.en: So which side of this argument is right?
sentences.zh: 那么，这个争论的哪一方是正确的？

sentences.en: It's likely to get harder because the Biden administration sees the end of Title 42 as an opportunity to make some pretty significant changes to how asylum works.
sentences.zh: 情况可能会变得更糟，因为拜登政府将第42条的结束视为对庇护运作方式进行重大改变的机会。

sentences.en: And those changes could mean that large numbers of migrants seeking asylum will no longer be able to do so at the border.
sentences.zh: 这些改变可能意味着大量寻求庇护的移民将不再能够在边境这样做。

sentences.en: And the reason the Biden administration wants to do that is really because we have an unprecedented number of people from around the world seeking entry into the United States.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府想要这样做的原因确实是因为我们有数量空前的来自世界各地的人寻求进入美国。

sentences.en: It's Russians trying to evade conscription as the war with Ukraine rages.
sentences.zh: 随着乌克兰战争的肆虐，俄罗斯人试图逃避征兵。

sentences.en: It's Afghans trying to escape the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 阿富汗人试图逃离塔利班。

sentences.en: It's Venezuelans, Haitians, Cubans, Colombians, Nicaraguans who are coming from countries whose economies have been ravaged by COVID.
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉人、海地人、古巴人、哥伦比亚人、尼加拉瓜人来自经济遭到新冠疫情破坏的国家。

sentences.en: And all those people that you just described, they're coming through Mexico, correct?
sentences.zh: 你刚才描述的所有这些人，他们都是通过墨西哥来的，对吗？

sentences.en: And almost all of them see this previous system of asylum in the U.S., the one that was in place before Title 42 as their best path into the United States.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有人都将以前的美国庇护系统（即第42条实施之前的系统）视为进入美国的最佳途径。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the reality is that long before Title 42 was put in place, the system was just not equipped to handle this number of people applying for asylum.
sentences.zh: 现实是，早在第42条实施之前，该系统根本没有能力处理这么多人申请庇护。

sentences.en: The system has been completely buckling.
sentences.zh: 这个系统已经彻底崩溃了。

sentences.en: So many people apply that there's often a five-year backlog until a case comes to completion.
sentences.zh: 申请的人太多，以至于案件审结往往需要五年的积压。

sentences.en: That's in part because it's not just people who qualify for asylum applying for it.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是不仅有符合庇护条件的人在申请。

sentences.en: They're also people taking advantage of the system.
sentences.zh: 还有人利用这个系统。

sentences.en: People who know they won't qualify still apply because they know that they can stay in the country
sentences.zh: 明知自己不符合资格的人仍然申请，因为他们知道自己可以留在国内

sentences.en: at least for the number of years it takes for their case to move through the system.
sentences.zh: 至少需要数年时间才能让他们的案件通过系统审理。

sentences.en: And the result of all this is that the system doesn't function as a working immigration policy.
sentences.zh: 这一切的结果是，该系统无法作为行之有效的移民政策运作。

sentences.en: So what exactly is the Biden administration's plan now that Title 42 is going away to change the way asylum works and to avoid this crush of people at the border?
sentences.zh: 那么，既然第42条即将取消，拜登政府改变庇护运作方式并避免边境人群拥挤的计划到底是什么？

sentences.en: Well, actually, the Biden administration has come up with two ways to try to discourage people from coming to the U.S.-Mexico border.
sentences.zh: 事实上，拜登政府已经想出了两种方法来试图阻止人们来到美墨边境。

sentences.en: The first is legal pathways for people to avoid making their journey altogether.
sentences.zh: 第一种是为人们完全避免踏上旅程提供合法途径。

sentences.en: And the second is actually making it harder for them to get in if they come to the border.
sentences.zh: 第二种是让他们如果来到边境更难进入。

sentences.en: Okay, let's start with the first, the idea of new legal pathways that might prevent people from making this dangerous trek to the U.S.-Mexico border.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们从第一个开始，即新的合法途径的想法，这可能会阻止人们进行前往美墨边境的危险跋涉。

sentences.en: What is that plan?
sentences.zh: 那个计划是什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's a patchwork of prograMs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一系列项目的拼凑。

sentences.en: The first one, called humanitarian parole, enables people from four countries, including Venezuela, Haiti, Cuba, and Nicaragua, to fly directly to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 第一个被称为人道主义假释，使来自委内瑞拉、海地、古巴和尼加拉瓜等四个国家的人能够直接飞往美国

sentences.en: rather than come to the border, provided they have a financial sponsor in the United States that commits to receiving them.
sentences.zh: 而不是来到边境，前提是他们在美国有经济赞助人承诺接待他们。

sentences.en: That alleviates pressure from the border.
sentences.zh: 这减轻了边境的压力。

sentences.en: Secondly, the administration recently announced that it will be setting up regional centers
sentences.zh: 其次，政府最近宣布将建立区域中心

sentences.en: for people to apply for refugee status in Colombia, Guatemala, and potentially other countries.
sentences.zh: 供人们在哥伦比亚、危地马拉以及可能其他国家申请难民身份。

sentences.en: Again, that would prevent people from coming all the way to the border.
sentences.zh: 同样，这将阻止人们一路来到边境。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In other words, seek your entry into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，寻求进入美国

sentences.en: long before you get to the U.S.-Mexico border.
sentences.zh: 远在你到达美墨边境之前。

sentences.en: Precisely.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And lastly, the administration unveiled a mobile app
sentences.zh: 最后，政府推出了一款移动应用程序

sentences.en: that enables migrants who are in Mexico to apply for an appointment for an interview with an immigration officer at the border.
sentences.zh: 它使身处墨西哥的移民能够申请在边境与移民官员面谈的预约。

sentences.en: Many of these migrants would normally come to the border and turn themselves in.
sentences.zh: 其中许多移民通常会来到边境并自首。

sentences.en: But the app is designed to create some order in the process, even if they're already in Mexico, having left their countries in South America or Asia.
sentences.zh: 但该应用程序旨在为这个过程带来一些秩序，即使他们已经在墨西哥，已经离开了他们在南美或亚洲的国家。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So the message embedded in all three of these plans is, there are ways of trying to get into the country that don't require you to come to the border,
sentences.zh: 因此，这三个计划中嵌入的信息是，有一些方法可以尝试进入该国家，而不需要你来到边境，

sentences.en: and please don't come to the border.
sentences.zh: 请不要来边境。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: But for migrants who are trying to reach the U.S., there are problems with all of these alternatives.
sentences.zh: 但对于试图到达美国的移民来说，所有这些替代方案都存在问题。

sentences.en: Such as?
sentences.zh: 比如？

sentences.en: Well, the problem with the humanitarian parole program is that many of these migrants don't have family or friends with means in the United States
sentences.zh: 嗯，人道主义假释计划的问题在于，许多这些移民在美国没有有钱的亲戚或朋友

sentences.en: to take responsibility for supporting them.
sentences.zh: 来承担支持他们的责任。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: The regional centers haven't yet been established, and it's not clear when they would be up and running.
sentences.zh: 区域中心尚未建立，目前尚不清楚它们何时会启动并运行。

sentences.en: The mobile app has probleMs.
sentences.zh: 移动应用程序有问题。

sentences.en: It offers a very limited number of appointments.
sentences.zh: 它提供的预约数量非常有限。

sentences.en: Those appointments fill up very quickly, almost instantly, and the app favors people who have good internet connection.
sentences.zh: 这些预约填满得非常快，几乎是瞬间完成，而且该应用程序偏爱网络连接良好的人。

sentences.en: I've talked to migrants who say that it crashes when they finally get on, or it doesn't accept the information they upload.
sentences.zh: 我跟移民谈过，他们说当他们终于登录时它会崩溃，或者它不接受他们上传的信息。

sentences.en: So some of these alternative means of applying to come to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，申请来美国的一些替代手段

sentences.en: are either a work in progress or not in place really at all at this point.
sentences.zh: 目前要么正在进行中，要么根本没有到位。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But the main problem the Biden administration is facing right now is that on top of all that, there are already tens of thousands of people
sentences.zh: 但拜登政府目前面临的主要问题是，最重要的是，已经有数万人

sentences.en: amassed on the Mexican side of the border, and they're still going to try to get in in a way that the government really doesn't want them to try.
sentences.zh: 聚集在墨西哥一侧的边境，他们仍然会试图以政府真正不希望他们尝试的方式进入。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Thirty-three presidents.
sentences.zh: 三十三位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning, and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星辰之外是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千个消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: Sixty super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 六十个超级圣代。
